description: Generate a full adb bugreport (system state, logs, dumpsys output for every service) and save it under .androidmcp-framework/artifacts/bugreports/ by default. This is comprehensive but slow - budget 1-3 minutes.

localOutputPath.description: Optional explicit output path. Defaults to the project artifacts folder.

projectPath.description: Project root for the bug report; defaults to the current working directory.

name: bug_report
title: Bug Report
